pokedexEntries.su: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

pokedexEntries.mo: Purple mucus sticks to the hands of anyone who touches it. Take care, as the substance is troublesome to wash off.

pokedexEntries.us: While they normally live in the sea, they can function on land, too, until their skin dries out.

pokedexEntries.um: When it senses danger, a purple liquid oozes out of it. The liquid is thought to be something like greasy sweat.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.

pokedexEntries.sh: Subjecting this Pokémon to a strong force causes it to secrete a strange purple fluid. Though harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
